cities.name: Mansfield
cities.tagline: High-country town below Mount Buller and Mount Stirling
cities.general: Mansfield is the Victorian high-country service town for Mount Buller, Mount Stirling, Howqua Valley walks, and the Great Victorian Rail Trail.
tips: Winter traffic backs up on the Buller road

cities.name: Warburton
cities.tagline: Yarra Ranges timber town below Mount Donna Buang
cities.general: Warburton sits on the Upper Yarra with rainforest walks, the O'Shannassy Aqueduct, and the Mount Donna Buang road and summit lookout.
activities: Drive or walk Mount Donna Buang
tips: The Donna Buang road ices in winter

cities.name: Marysville
cities.tagline: Mountain-ash village for Steavenson Falls and Lake Mountain
cities.general: Marysville is a rebuilt high-country village with waterfall walks, Lake Mountain snow play, and forest roads toward the Cathedral Range.

cities.name: Mount Buller
cities.tagline: Victorian ski-resort village and summer alpine walking base
cities.general: Mount Buller village sits on the summit plateau with summer walking, bike trails, and winter ski fields above Mansfield.
tips: The access road is steep and seasonal
Village services thin out midweek in summer

cities.name: Dinner Plain
cities.tagline: High-plains village between Hotham and Omeo
cities.general: Dinner Plain is a timber alpine village on the Great Alpine Road, with hut-country walks, cross-country trails, and easy access to Mount Hotham.
tips: Fuel up before the alpine section

cities.name: Charlotte Pass
cities.tagline: Highest village in Australia and Main Range trailhead
cities.general: Charlotte Pass is the snow-country trailhead for the Main Range, Mount Kosciuszko, Mount Twynam, and summer alpine lakes above Jindabyne.
tips: The road is often closed in winter
Start early; weather closes in fast

cities.name: Coonabarabran
cities.tagline: Warrumbungle gateway for the Breadknife and Siding Spring
cities.general: Coonabarabran is the service town for Warrumbungle National Park, with dark-sky observatories and volcanic-plug walking country.

cities.name: Melrose
cities.tagline: Southern Flinders village at the foot of Mount Remarkable
cities.general: Melrose is a small stone-and-pub village beneath Mount Remarkable, with the summit hike, Alligator Gorge nearby, and the Mawson Trail.
tips: Pub and cafe hours are limited midweek

cities.name: Tamborine Mountain
cities.tagline: Scenic Rim plateau of rainforest walks and lookouts
cities.general: Tamborine Mountain is a rainforest plateau village with short waterfall walks, galleries, and views back to the Gold Coast and Border Ranges.
tips: A car is easiest between reserves

cities.name: Boonah
cities.tagline: Scenic Rim town for Mount French, Greville, and Moogerah peaks
cities.general: Boonah sits under the Moogerah Peaks with paddocks, a small main street, and steep walk-up plugs including Mount French and Mount Greville.
activities: Continue to Rathdowney or Cunninghams Gap
tips: Start peak walks early in summer
Rock is loose on some plugs
Carry more water than the distance suggests

cities.name: Canungra
cities.tagline: Lamington gateway village below the Green Mountains road
cities.general: Canungra is the last service village before Binna Burra and O'Reilly's, with hinterland cafes and access to Lamington rainforest walks.
tips: The range roads are winding and wet

cities.name: Porongurup
cities.general: Porongurup is a tiny Great Southern village under the granite range, with Castle Rock, Nancy Peak, and cellar doors on the flats.
activities: Continue to Stirling Range or Albany
tips: Services are limited; shop in Mount Barker or Albany

cities.name: Walhalla
cities.tagline: Gold-era mountain village below Baw Baw country
cities.general: Walhalla is a restored gold town in a steep Gippsland valley, with tramway walks, mine tours, and access toward Baw Baw and the Thomson country.
tips: The road is narrow and winding
Winter shade keeps the valley cold

cities.name: Khancoban
cities.tagline: Western Snowy Mountains town on the Alpine Way
cities.general: Khancoban sits on the western side of Kosciuszko with dam country, the Alpine Way to Thredbo, and access toward Jagungal and Geehi.
tips: The Alpine Way closes in heavy snow
Carry fuel and food over the range

cities.name: Omeo
cities.tagline: High-country gold town on the Great Alpine Road
cities.general: Omeo is a small East Gippsland alpine town with gold history, the Great Alpine Road to Hotham, and access to Bogong High Plains loops.
activities: Drive to Dinner Plain and Hotham
Continue to Mitta Mitta or Bruthen

cities.name: Twizel
cities.tagline: Mackenzie Basin town for Aoraki walks and canal country
cities.general: Twizel is the practical base for Aoraki / Mount Cook approaches, glacial lakes, and high-country walks on the southern side of the Alps.

cities.name: Mount Cook Village
cities.tagline: Aoraki trailhead village for Hooker, Mueller, and Sealy walks
cities.general: Aoraki / Mount Cook Village sits under New Zealand's highest peak, with glacier-valley walks, hut climbs, and avalanche-aware alpine terrain.
activities: Climb to Sealy Tarns or Mueller Hut
tips: Alpine weather kills; turn back early

parks.name: Main Range National Park
parks.tagline: Cunninghams Gap rainforest and walk-up peaks on the Great Dividing Range
parks.summary: Main Range National Park protects rainforest, cliff lines, and peaks such as Mount Cordeaux, Mount Mitchell, and Bare Rock on the Scenic Rim.

parks.name: Moogerah Peaks National Park
parks.tagline: Steep volcanic plugs west of Boonah, including Mount French and Mount Greville
parks.summary: Moogerah Peaks National Park is a cluster of rhyolite plugs with short, steep summit walks above Lake Moogerah and the Fassifern Valley.

parks.name: Paluma Range National Park
parks.tagline: Wet Tropics cloud forest and Mount Spec walks above Townsville
parks.summary: Paluma Range National Park covers rainforest, granite creeks, and lookouts on the Mount Spec range, with cooler air than the coastal plain.

parks.name: Mount Walsh National Park
parks.tagline: Granite peak and woodland walks above Biggenden
parks.summary: Mount Walsh National Park is a steep granite massif in the North Burnett, with a rocky summit pad and wide views over the Wide Bay hinterland.

parks.name: Tamborine National Park
parks.tagline: Scattered rainforest reserves on the Tamborine plateau
parks.summary: Tamborine National Park is a set of small rainforest and waterfall reserves on Tamborine Mountain, with short walks and escarpment lookouts.

parks.name: Kanangra-Boyd National Park
parks.tagline: Deep sandstone gorges and Kanangra Walls west of the Blue Mountains
parks.summary: Kanangra-Boyd National Park protects wild sandstone plateaus, the Kanangra Walls lookouts, and long walks toward Mount Cloudmaker and the Kowmung.

parks.name: Cathedral Rock National Park
parks.tagline: Granite tors and a short summit walk on the New England tablelands
parks.summary: Cathedral Rock National Park is a compact granite park east of Armidale, with a steep pad to a summit maze of boulders and snow gums.

parks.name: New England National Park
parks.tagline: World Heritage escarpment, Point Lookout, and cool-temperate forest
parks.summary: New England National Park drops from Point Lookout through Antarctic beech and gorge country on the eastern escarpment of the tablelands.

parks.name: Gulaga National Park
parks.tagline: Sacred coastal mountain above Tilba and the far south coast
parks.summary: Gulaga National Park protects the culturally important mountain of Gulaga / Mount Dromedary, with a long forest climb from the Tilba side.

parks.name: Mount Imlay National Park
parks.tagline: Isolated far-south peak above Eden and the Genoa country
parks.summary: Mount Imlay National Park is a steep forested peak inland from Eden, with a hard summit walk and views to the coast and hinterland.

parks.name: Baw Baw National Park
parks.tagline: Snow-gum plateau, ski fields, and summer alpine walking in Gippsland
parks.summary: Baw Baw National Park covers a subalpine plateau east of Melbourne, with village walks, Mount St Gwinear, and winter snow country.

parks.name: Yarra Ranges National Park
parks.tagline: Mountain-ash forests, Donna Buang, and Melbourne's forested catchment
parks.summary: Yarra Ranges National Park protects tall wet forest, Mount Donna Buang, Rainforest Gallery, and closed catchment ridges above the Yarra.

parks.name: Mount Arapiles-Tooan State Park
parks.tagline: World-class climbing crag and short summit pads in the Wimmera
parks.summary: Mount Arapiles-Tooan State Park is a quartzite island in the Wimmera, famous for climbing and for short walking pads to Mitre Rock and the summit.

parks.name: Porongurup National Park
parks.tagline: Karri and granite skywalks east of the Stirling Range
parks.summary: Porongurup National Park is a compact granite range with Castle Rock, Nancy Peak, and karri forest above the Great Southern vineyards.

parks.name: Wellington Park
parks.tagline: Hobart's mountain park, from The Springs to the kunanyi pinnacle
parks.summary: Wellington Park covers kunanyi / Mount Wellington and the surrounding ridges, with alpine pads, Organ Pipes, and city-to-summit walking.

parks.name: Egmont National Park
parks.tagline: Taranaki volcano, rainforest, and Pouakai crossing country
parks.summary: Egmont National Park rings Taranaki Maunga with rainforest, alpine scoria, and day walks such as Pouakai Crossing and the summit route.

parks.name: Nelson Lakes National Park
parks.tagline: Beech-forest lakes and the Robert Ridge to Angelus Hut
parks.summary: Nelson Lakes National Park is beech-forest lake country with the Robert Ridge, Angelus Hut, and Mount Robert day walks above St Arnaud.

hikes.name: Mount Maroon Walk
hikes.tagline: Steep Scenic Rim climb near Rathdowney
hikes.summary: The Mount Maroon walk climbs from the western trailhead through open forest and steep rock to a broad summit with Border Ranges views.
tips: Rock slabs are slick after rain
hikes.start_instructions: Start from the signed car park on Maroon Dam Road.

hikes.name: Mount Cordeaux Walk
hikes.tagline: Cunninghams Gap rainforest climb to a clifftop lookout
hikes.summary: The Mount Cordeaux track rises from Cunninghams Gap through rainforest and cliff-edge pads to a lookout over the Fassifern Valley.
tips: The cliff edge is unfenced in places
Start early; the gap road is noisy
hikes.start_instructions: Park at Cunninghams Gap and take the Mount Cordeaux track on the northern side.

hikes.name: Mount Mitchell Walk
hikes.tagline: Rainforest ridge opposite Cordeaux at Cunninghams Gap
hikes.summary: The Mount Mitchell walk climbs the southern side of Cunninghams Gap through rainforest to twin peaks with Scenic Rim views.
tips: The ridge is muddy after rain
Carry a jacket; cloud sits on the gap
hikes.start_instructions: Start from Cunninghams Gap and take the southern Mount Mitchell track.

hikes.name: Bare Rock Walk
hikes.tagline: Longer Main Range walk to an exposed clifftop
hikes.summary: Bare Rock continues past the Mount Cordeaux junction along the Main Range escarpment to an open clifftop with huge western views.
tips: This is a longer day than Cordeaux alone
hikes.start_instructions: Follow the Mount Cordeaux track, then continue to Bare Rock.

hikes.name: Mount Greville Walk
hikes.tagline: Palm-gorge and ridge climb of a Moogerah plug
hikes.summary: Mount Greville can be climbed by the palm gorge or ridge lines, with steep rock, rainforest, and a small summit above Lake Moogerah.
hikes.start_instructions: Start from the signed car park off Lake Moogerah Road.

hikes.name: Mount French Walk
hikes.tagline: Short steep summit above Lake Moogerah
hikes.summary: The Mount French walk climbs from the picnic area through open forest and rock to a lookout over the Fassifern Valley and lake.
hikes.start_instructions: Start from the Mount French day-use area west of Boonah.

hikes.name: Flinders Peak Walk
hikes.tagline: Ipswich-region climb with Scenic Rim and city views
hikes.summary: The Flinders Peak walk rises from the northern trailhead through woodland and steep pads to a rocky summit above the Amberley plain.
tips: Little shade on the upper slope
hikes.start_instructions: Start from the Peak Crossing / Flinders Peak trailhead.

hikes.name: Mount Beerburum Walk
hikes.tagline: Steep Glass House plug with a summit fire tower
hikes.summary: The Mount Beerburum walk is a short, steep climb through woodland to a rocky summit and fire tower above the Glass House group.
hikes.start_instructions: Start from the signed car park off Steve Irwin Way.

hikes.name: Mount Stuart Lookout Walk
hikes.tagline: Townsville city-mountain pads and lookouts
hikes.summary: Mount Stuart has short summit pads and a road lookout with views over Townsville, Cleveland Bay, and Magnetic Island.
tips: Carry water; the ridge is dry
hikes.start_instructions: Drive or walk the Mount Stuart road to the summit precinct.

hikes.name: Mount Archer Summit Walk
hikes.tagline: Berserker Range climb above Rockhampton
hikes.summary: The Mount Archer walks climb from the city-side trails to the Berserker Range lookout, with river and hinterland views.
tips: Combine with the summit road lookouts
hikes.start_instructions: Start from the Frenchville / Mount Archer trailheads on the city side.

hikes.name: Mount Walsh Summit Walk
hikes.tagline: Granite scramble above Biggenden
hikes.summary: The Mount Walsh summit walk climbs steep granite and woodland from the picnic area to a rocky high point in the North Burnett.
tips: The route is unmarked in places near the top
hikes.start_instructions: Start from the picnic area south of Biggenden.

hikes.name: Purling Brook Falls Circuit
hikes.tagline: Springbrook plateau walk to the waterfall and rainforest gorge
hikes.summary: The Purling Brook circuit drops from the Springbrook plateau through rainforest to the falls lookouts and climbs back through antarctic beech country.
hikes.start_instructions: Start from the Purling Brook Falls car park on the Springbrook plateau.

hikes.name: Best of All Lookout Walk
hikes.tagline: Short Springbrook pad to Mount Warning and coast views
hikes.summary: The Best of All Lookout walk is a short rainforest pad to a clifftop platform looking south to Wollumbin / Mount Warning and the Tweed.
hikes.start_instructions: Park at the end of Repeater Station Road, Springbrook.

hikes.name: Mount Hypipamee Crater Walk
hikes.tagline: Dinner Falls and the volcanic pipe on the Atherton Tableland
hikes.summary: A short circuit links Dinner Falls lookouts with the fenced Mount Hypipamee crater, a deep volcanic pipe in the Wet Tropics.
tips: The crater fence is there for a reason
hikes.start_instructions: Start from the Mount Hypipamee day-use area on the Kennedy Highway.

hikes.name: Mount Stilwell Walk
hikes.tagline: Short alpine summit above Charlotte Pass
hikes.summary: The Mount Stilwell walk climbs from Charlotte Pass through snow-gum woodland and alpine herbfield to a small summit with Main Range views.
tips: Combine with the Main Range or Kosciuszko
hikes.start_instructions: Start from Charlotte Pass village and follow Mount Stilwell signs.

hikes.name: Mount Twynam Walk
hikes.tagline: Main Range traverse to Australia's third-highest peak
hikes.summary: The Mount Twynam walk follows the Main Range from Charlotte Pass past Blue Lake and the high ridge to Twynam, with glacial lakes and big alpine weather.
tips: This is a long exposed day
Turn back if cloud or wind rises
Carry sun, wind, and emergency layers
hikes.start_instructions: Start from Charlotte Pass and follow the Main Range toward Blue Lake and Twynam.

hikes.name: Mount Tate Walk
hikes.tagline: Snowy River high-country climb from Guthega
hikes.summary: The Mount Tate walk climbs from Guthega through snow gums and open ridge to a Kosciuszko-group summit above the Snowy River.
tips: Carry a map; pads fade in snow
hikes.start_instructions: Start from Guthega and follow the Illawong / Tate pads.

hikes.name: Mount Exmouth Walk
hikes.tagline: Longest Warrumbungle day walk to the range high point
hikes.summary: The Mount Exmouth walk is a long volcanic-range day from Camp Blackman through forest and ridge to the highest peak in the Warrumbungles.
tips: The stairs and ridge are exposed
hikes.start_instructions: Start from Camp Blackman in Warrumbungle National Park.

hikes.name: Belougery Split Rock Walk
hikes.tagline: Volcanic-plug circuit in the Warrumbungles
hikes.summary: The Split Rock walk climbs around and onto Belougery Split Rock, with short steep pads and views to the Breadknife and High Tops.
tips: Good shorter alternative to the High Tops
hikes.start_instructions: Start from the Split Rock car park in Warrumbungle National Park.

hikes.name: Mount Imlay Summit Walk
hikes.tagline: Steep far-south climb inland from Eden
hikes.summary: The Mount Imlay walk is a relentless forest and ridge climb to a small summit with coast and hinterland views.
tips: Almost no water on the hill
The descent is hard on knees
hikes.start_instructions: Start from the signed car park off Burrawang Forest Road.

hikes.name: Gulaga Mountain Walk
hikes.tagline: Long forest climb of the sacred mountain above Tilba
hikes.summary: The Gulaga walk climbs from Tilba country through forest to the culturally important summit; walkers should treat the mountain with respect and follow local guidance.
tips: This is a long, steep day
hikes.start_instructions: Start from the signed Tilba / Gulaga trailhead.

hikes.name: Mount Kembla Summit Walk
hikes.tagline: Illawarra escarpment climb above Wollongong
hikes.summary: The Mount Kembla walk climbs from the village through forest to a summit lookout with coast and escarpment views.
hikes.start_instructions: Start from the village trailheads on Cordeaux Road.

hikes.name: Ruined Castle Walk
hikes.tagline: Jamison Valley walk to the rock towers below Mount Solitary
hikes.summary: The Ruined Castle walk drops from the Golden Stairs or Scenic World side, crosses the Federal Pass, and climbs to the rock towers on the Solitary saddle.
tips: The stairs are long both ways
Carry a light if you start late
hikes.start_instructions: Start from the Golden Stairs car park on Glenraphael Drive.

hikes.name: Kanangra Walls Walk
hikes.tagline: Short plateau walk to the sandstone amphitheatre
hikes.summary: The Kanangra Walls walk crosses heath and clifftop pads to lookouts over the walls, Dance Floor Cave country, and the deep Kowmung gorges.
tips: The last road is long and unsealed
hikes.start_instructions: Drive Kanangra Walls Road to the end car park.

hikes.name: Cathedral Rock Walk
hikes.tagline: Granite-tor maze on the New England tablelands
hikes.summary: The Cathedral Rock walk climbs through snow gums and boulder fields to a summit maze with tablelands views.
tips: The granite scramble is awkward with a pack
It can be cold even in summer
hikes.start_instructions: Start from the picnic area in Cathedral Rock National Park.

hikes.name: Point Lookout Walk
hikes.tagline: Escarpment platforms above New England gorges
hikes.summary: Short boardwalks and pads lead to Point Lookout platforms with World Heritage gorge and ocean-horizon views.
tips: Cloud often sits on the escarpment
It is much colder than Armidale
hikes.start_instructions: Drive to Point Lookout in New England National Park.

hikes.name: Mount Ainslie Summit Walk
hikes.tagline: Canberra land-axis climb to the city lookout
hikes.summary: The Mount Ainslie walk climbs from the War Memorial through woodland to the summit lookout on Canberra's land axis.
hikes.start_instructions: Start from the War Memorial and follow the Mount Ainslie summit track.

hikes.name: Black Mountain Summit Walk
hikes.tagline: Bush trails to the Telstra Tower ridge
hikes.summary: Black Mountain walks climb through dry forest to the tower precinct and lookouts over Lake Burley Griffin and the Brindabellas.
hikes.start_instructions: Start from the Aranda or Botanic Gardens side tracks.

hikes.name: Mount Gingera Walk
hikes.tagline: Namadgi snow-gum ridge to a high ACT summit
hikes.summary: The Mount Gingera walk follows the Mount Franklin Road and snow-gum ridge from Corin / Pryors Hut country to a windswept Namadgi summit.
tips: This is a long, cold ridge
The last road is unsealed and seasonal
hikes.start_instructions: Start from the Mount Franklin Road snow-gum trailheads south of Bulls Head.

hikes.name: Mount Howitt Walk
hikes.tagline: Victorian Alpine Walking Track climb to the Crosscut Saw
hikes.summary: The Mount Howitt walk climbs from Howitt car park through forest and snow-gum ridges to the summit and the start of the Crosscut Saw.
tips: Snow and ice linger into spring
hikes.start_instructions: Start from the Howitt car park on the Howitt Road.

hikes.name: Mount Cobbler Walk
hikes.tagline: Isolated alpine peak above Lake Cobbler
hikes.summary: The Mount Cobbler walk climbs from Lake Cobbler through snow gums to a small summit with views over the Buffalo and King country.
tips: The access road is long and rough
hikes.start_instructions: Drive the Lake Cobbler road and start from the lake campground.

hikes.name: Mount Hotham Summit Walk
hikes.tagline: Great Alpine Road village walk to the Hotham cairn
hikes.summary: A short alpine pad leads from Hotham village and the road to the summit cairn, with views to Feathertop and the Razorback.
hikes.start_instructions: Start from Hotham village or the summit road pullover.

hikes.name: Mount Loch Walk
hikes.tagline: High-plains walk from Hotham toward the Razorback
hikes.summary: The Mount Loch walk crosses snow-gum and herbfield from Hotham toward Loch and the Feathertop Razorback junction.
tips: Snow poles mark the winter route
hikes.start_instructions: Start from Hotham village and follow Mount Loch / Razorback signs.

hikes.name: Mount Feathertop via the Razorback
hikes.tagline: High ridgeline from Hotham to Feathertop
hikes.summary: The Razorback is the classic high traverse from Mount Hotham to Mount Feathertop, staying on an exposed alpine ridge for most of the day.
tips: Do not start in bad weather
There is almost no water on the ridge
This is longer and more exposed than Bungalow Spur
hikes.start_instructions: Start from Diamantina Hut on the Great Alpine Road near Hotham.

hikes.name: Mount Baw Baw Summit Walk
hikes.tagline: Snow-gum village walk to the Baw Baw cairn
hikes.summary: A short plateau walk leads from Baw Baw village through snow gums to the summit, with Gippsland and alpine views.
tips: The plateau is cold and wet
hikes.start_instructions: Start from the village and follow summit-walk signs.

hikes.name: Mount Oberon Summit Walk
hikes.tagline: Wilsons Promontory granite climb above Tidal River
hikes.summary: The Mount Oberon walk uses the service road and a steep granite pad to the lookout above Tidal River, with coast and island views.
tips: Start early; parking at Tidal River fills
hikes.start_instructions: Take the Tidal River shuttle or walk to Telegraph Saddle, then climb Oberon.

hikes.name: Mount Rosea Walk
hikes.tagline: Grampians clifftop peak above Halls Gap
hikes.summary: The Mount Rosea walk climbs from Halls Gap / Silverband country through sandstone and forest to a clifftop summit with Wonderland views.
hikes.start_instructions: Start from the Mount Rosea car park off Silverband Road.

hikes.name: Mount Stapylton Loop
hikes.tagline: Northern Grampians sandstone fortress near Mount Zero
hikes.summary: The Stapylton loop winds through hollows, cliffs, and hollow-mountain pads in the northern Gariwerd group.
tips: This is a scramble in places
hikes.start_instructions: Start from the Stapylton campground off Mount Zero Road.

hikes.name: Mount Abrupt Walk
hikes.tagline: Southern Grampians climb above Dunkeld
hikes.summary: The Mount Abrupt walk climbs steeply from the Grampians Tourist Road to a sharp southern summit with Dunkeld and western-district views.
hikes.start_instructions: Start from the signed car park north of Dunkeld.

hikes.name: Mount Arapiles Summit Walk
hikes.tagline: Short pad to the Wimmera climbing mountain
hikes.summary: A short walking pad climbs from the picnic grounds to the Arapiles summit lookout, with Mitre Rock and plains views.
hikes.start_instructions: Start from the main picnic area at Mount Arapiles.

hikes.name: The Balconies Walk
hikes.tagline: Short Gariwerd walk to the Jaws of Death lookout
hikes.summary: The Balconies walk is a short pad from the Reed Lookout area to the famous sandstone jaws above the Victoria Valley.
tips: Combine with Boroka or the Pinnacle
hikes.start_instructions: Park at Reed Lookout and walk the signed Balconies track.

hikes.name: Mount Buller Summit Walk
hikes.tagline: Village pad to the Buller cairn
hikes.summary: A short alpine walk leads from Mount Buller village to the summit cairn and Corn Hill views.
hikes.start_instructions: Start from the village centre and follow summit signs.

hikes.name: Mount Donna Buang Walk
hikes.tagline: Rainforest climb from Warburton to the lookout tower
hikes.summary: The Donna Buang walk climbs from Warburton through mountain ash and rainforest to the summit tower above the Upper Yarra.
tips: The road is an alternative in winter ice
hikes.start_instructions: Start from Warburton and follow the Donna Buang road / walking tracks.

hikes.name: Mount McKay Walk
hikes.tagline: Falls Creek high-plains summit
hikes.summary: A short high-plains walk leads from Falls Creek toward Mount McKay, with hut-country and Kiewa Valley views.
tips: Weather is alpine even in January
hikes.start_instructions: Start from Falls Creek village and follow McKay / high-plains signs.

hikes.name: Mount Bruce / Punurrunha Walk
hikes.tagline: Karijini high-country climb in the Hamersley Range
hikes.summary: The Mount Bruce walk climbs from the Karijini west side through spinifex and rock to one of Western Australia's highest summits.
hikes.start_instructions: Start from the signed Mount Bruce car park in Karijini National Park.

hikes.name: Mount Nameless / Jarndunmunha Walk
hikes.tagline: Tom Price town peak with a steep summit
hikes.summary: The Jarndunmunha walk climbs from Tom Price to a rocky summit with Hamersley and mine-country views.
tips: The summit road is an alternative for drivers
hikes.start_instructions: Start from the signed trailhead on the western side of Tom Price.

hikes.name: Mount Trio Walk
hikes.tagline: Stirling Range ridge near Bluff Knoll
hikes.summary: The Mount Trio walk climbs a short, steep Stirling ridge with wildflower-season views to Bluff Knoll and Toolbrunup.
tips: Add this to a Bluff Knoll day if you have time
Wind on the ridge is strong
hikes.start_instructions: Start from the Mount Trio car park on Stirling Range Drive.

hikes.name: Talyuberlup Peak Walk
hikes.tagline: Short Stirling Range scramble west of Toolbrunup
hikes.summary: Talyuberlup is a steep, rocky Stirling climb with a short approach and a sharp summit.
tips: Avoid in wet or high wind
hikes.start_instructions: Start from the Talyuberlup car park on Stirling Range Drive.

hikes.name: Mount Hassell Walk
hikes.tagline: Short Stirling summit near the Bluff Knoll road
hikes.summary: Mount Hassell is a short, steep pad from the Bluff Knoll approach country to a rocky Stirling summit.
tips: Combine with Bluff Knoll only if you start very early
hikes.start_instructions: Start from the signed pullover on the Bluff Knoll approach road.

hikes.name: Mount Lindesay Walk
hikes.tagline: Granite peak north of Denmark
hikes.summary: The Mount Lindesay walk climbs through forest and steep granite to a summit with Great Southern and inlet views.
hikes.start_instructions: Start from the car park north of Denmark off Mount Lindesay Road.

hikes.name: Mount Gillen Walk
hikes.tagline: Alice Springs west-side ridge above Heavitree Gap
hikes.summary: The Mount Gillen walk climbs the west-side ridge above Alice Springs, with town, gap, and MacDonnell views.
hikes.start_instructions: Start from the signed west-side trailhead off Larapinta Drive.

hikes.name: Valley of the Winds Walk
hikes.tagline: Kata Tjuta circuit through the domes
hikes.summary: The Valley of the Winds walk threads between the Kata Tjuta domes to Karu and Karingana lookouts, with huge Red Centre walls and desert light.
tips: The circuit can close in extreme heat
Carry more water than you think
hikes.start_name: Valley of the Winds car park
hikes.end_name: Valley of the Winds car park
hikes.start_instructions: Start from the Valley of the Winds car park in Uluru–Kata Tjuta National Park.

hikes.name: Walpa Gorge Walk
hikes.tagline: Short Kata Tjuta gorge between two great walls
hikes.summary: Walpa Gorge is a short out-and-back between steep conglomerate walls at the western side of Kata Tjuta.
tips: Go early or late for shade
The gorge can close in extreme heat
hikes.start_instructions: Start from the Walpa Gorge car park.

hikes.name: Barn Bluff Side Trip
hikes.tagline: Overland Track dolerite climb near Cradle Mountain
hikes.summary: The Barn Bluff side trip leaves the Overland Track near Waterfall Valley and climbs dolerite to a sharp summit beside Cradle.
tips: The upper rock is a scramble
This is a side trip, not a shortcut
hikes.start_instructions: Leave the Overland Track near Waterfall Valley and follow the Barn Bluff pad.

hikes.name: The Acropolis Walk
hikes.tagline: Dolerite tower from Pine Valley on the Overland Track
hikes.summary: The Acropolis walk climbs from Pine Valley through rainforest and scree to a dolerite rampart in the Du Cane Range.
tips: Pine Valley is a side trip from the Overland
hikes.start_instructions: From Pine Valley hut, follow the Acropolis track.

hikes.name: Mount Anne Circuit High Point
hikes.tagline: South-west Tasmania quartzite traverse to Mount Anne
hikes.summary: The Mount Anne walk climbs from the Scotts Peak / Condominium Creek side through scrub and quartzite to one of the south-west's great summits.
tips: This is a serious, remote walk
Carry a tent and extra days of food
hikes.start_instructions: Start from the Mount Anne trackhead off the Scotts Peak Road.

hikes.name: Legges Tor Walk
hikes.tagline: Ben Lomond plateau walk to Tasmania's second-highest point
hikes.summary: A short plateau walk from the Ben Lomond ski village leads to Legges Tor, with dolerite and north-east views.
hikes.start_instructions: Drive Jacobs Ladder to the village and walk the plateau pads.

hikes.name: Mount Arthur Walk
hikes.tagline: Launceston hinterland summit above Lilydale
hikes.summary: The Mount Arthur walk climbs from the Lilydale side through forest and open pads to a dolerite summit with Tamar and north-east views.
hikes.start_instructions: Start from the signed trailhead south of Lilydale.

hikes.name: kunanyi Pinnacle Track
hikes.tagline: Hobart city-to-alpine pad from The Springs to the pinnacle
hikes.summary: The Pinnacle Track climbs from The Springs through subalpine woodland and dolerite to the kunanyi summit precinct above Hobart.
tips: Weather can be wintery in any month
Carry a layer even if the city is warm
hikes.start_instructions: Start from The Springs on Pinnacle Road.

hikes.name: Roys Peak Track
hikes.tagline: Wānaka's signature ridgeline climb
hikes.summary: The Roys Peak track climbs from the lake road through tussock to a ridgeline summit with the classic Wānaka and alps view.
tips: Start before dawn for parking and light
There is no water on the hill
hikes.start_instructions: Start from the signed car park on the Wanaka–Mount Aspiring Road.

hikes.name: Ben Lomond Track
hikes.tagline: Queenstown summit above the gondola
hikes.summary: The Ben Lomond track climbs from the gondola or Tiki Trail through tussock and scree to the summit above Queenstown and Lake Wakatipu.
hikes.start_instructions: Start from the Tiki Trail in Queenstown or ride the gondola and climb from the top station.

hikes.name: Isthmus Peak Track
hikes.tagline: Lake Hāwea ridgeline opposite Wānaka
hikes.summary: The Isthmus Peak track climbs from the Hāwea lake road to a long ridgeline with views over both lakes and the alps.
tips: Wind on the ridge is strong
hikes.start_instructions: Start from the signed car park on the Lake Hāwea road.

hikes.name: Sealy Tarns Track
hikes.tagline: Stairway to Mueller Hut country under Aoraki
hikes.summary: The Sealy Tarns track climbs a long staircase from the Hooker Valley road to tarns on the Sealy Range, with Aoraki and Mueller Glacier views.
tips: This is also the Mueller Hut approach
Turn back if ice or avalanche risk is up
hikes.start_instructions: Start from White Horse Hill campground / Hooker Valley car park.

hikes.name: Mueller Hut Route
hikes.tagline: Alpine hut climb on the Sealy Range
hikes.summary: Beyond Sealy Tarns the Mueller Hut route crosses scree and snow-pole country to a hut under Aoraki, with crevasse and avalanche terrain nearby.
tips: This is an alpine route, not a valley walk
Book the hut and check avalanche advice
hikes.start_instructions: Start from White Horse Hill and continue past Sealy Tarns on the hut route.

hikes.name: Avalanche Peak Track
hikes.tagline: Arthur's Pass scramble with alps on both sides
hikes.summary: Avalanche Peak is a steep tussock and rock climb from Arthur's Pass village, often done as a loop with the Scotts Track.
tips: Do not go in high wind or snow
hikes.start_instructions: Start from Arthur's Pass village on the Avalanche Peak or Scotts Track.

hikes.name: Pouakai Crossing
hikes.tagline: Taranaki day crossing of rainforest, tarns, and volcanic slopes
hikes.summary: The Pouakai Crossing climbs from Mangorei or North Egmont through rainforest and the Pouakai Range, with tarns and Taranaki views.
tips: Weather on the cone is severe
hikes.start_instructions: Most walkers start at Mangorei Road and finish at North Egmont.

hikes.name: Ngauruhoe Summit Route
hikes.tagline: Scree scramble off the Tongariro Alpine Crossing
hikes.summary: The Ngauruhoe route leaves the crossing and climbs steep scoria to the crater rim; it is a serious side trip, not part of the main crossing.
tips: Turn back in ice or high wind
This is optional and often discouraged in poor conditions
hikes.start_instructions: Leave the crossing at the signed Ngauruhoe junction only in stable weather.

hikes.name: Mauao / Mount Maunganui Summit Track
hikes.tagline: Coastal volcanic cone at the Tauranga heads
hikes.summary: The Mauao tracks climb from the base of Mount Maunganui through pōhutukawa and rock to a summit with harbour and ocean views.
hikes.start_instructions: Start from the base tracks at the Mount Maunganui beach / harbour side.

hikes.name: Rangitoto Summit Walk
hikes.tagline: Auckland volcanic island lava-field climb
hikes.summary: The Rangitoto summit walk crosses lava fields from the island wharf to the crater rim and lookout, with gulf and city views.
tips: There is no water or shade
Lava is sharp; wear proper shoes
hikes.start_instructions: Take the ferry to Rangitoto and follow the summit track from the wharf.

hikes.name: Key Summit Track
hikes.tagline: Routeburn day walk above The Divide
hikes.summary: The Key Summit track climbs from The Divide on the Milford Road through beech forest to alpine tarns and a lookout over the Darran and Humboldt mountains.
tips: This is the easy end of the Routeburn
hikes.start_instructions: Start from The Divide car park on the Te Anau–Milford Highway.

hikes.name: Gertrude Saddle Route
hikes.tagline: Alpine saddle from the Hollyford / Milford Road
hikes.summary: The Gertrude Saddle route climbs from the Gertrude Valley through rock and snow-pole country to a Darran Mountains saddle with black-rock and waterfall views.
tips: Ice and avalanche risk in shoulder seasons
Turn back if the creek is high
hikes.start_instructions: Start from the Gertrude Valley car park off the Milford Road.

hikes.name: Queenstown Hill Time Walk
hikes.tagline: Town hill climb to the basket-of-dreams lookout
hikes.summary: The Queenstown Hill walk climbs from town through pines and tussock to a lookout over Lake Wakatipu and the Remarkables.
hikes.start_instructions: Start from the Belfast Terrace trailhead in Queenstown.

hikes.name: Mount Iron Track
hikes.tagline: Short Wānaka hill with lake and alps views
hikes.summary: The Mount Iron track is a short loop or out-and-back from Wānaka to a rocky hilltop with lake, Clutha, and alps views.
tips: A good warm-up before Roys Peak
hikes.start_instructions: Start from the Mount Iron car park on the Cardrona road.
